does_not_do: It extracts structure; it does not interpret financial content. 768 open issues reflect a large user base and a wide format surface.
focus_reason: Local parsing with table structure is the need. 103 releases in the year and tests in CI; the open-issue count is high.
measured_against: Need: turn statements and filings (PDF and office files) into text and tables a program can read, locally.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; main, heavy-example and documentation CI workflows.
what_it_is: A document-processing library: parses PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, email and image formats, with page layout, reading order and table structure for PDFs. Runs locally.
